description: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India (NewsVoir) Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis unveiled report of the first ever AI-powered skill census in India, in the Cabinet Meeting at Mantralaya in Mumbai. The report was presented in the form of a coffee table book. An initiative by the Office of the District Collector, Mumbai Suburban, and the District Skill Development, Employment and Entrepreneurship Guidance Centre, Mumbai Suburban, Government of Maharashtra, the Saksham Skill Census was conducted in the H-West ward of the Mumbai Suburban District, as a pilot.
